s: And Judas begat Phares and «Zara» of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;

G2193.d: till, until; as long as, while; until, unto; until; as far as, even to, unto
s: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, «till» he should pay the debt.
For all the prophets and the law prophesied «until» John.
I must work the works of him that sent me, «while» it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.

G2147.d: to find; with or without previous search; to find, find out; learn, discover; to find for oneself, gain, procure, obtain
s: And he came and «found» them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.
Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall «find», bid to the marriage.

G2192.d: to have; to have, hold, hold fast; to hold; as, in the hand; to bear, wear; to be with child; to hold fast, keep; to involve; to hold, consider; to have, possess; according to your means; of parts or members; of complaints and disputes; to be able; of necessity; to be in a certain condition; to be ill …
s: For he taught them as one «having» authority, and not as the scribes.
But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all «hold» John as a prophet.

G2117.d: straight, direct; In moral sense, straightforward, right
s: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths «straight».
Ye serpents, ye generation of «vipers», how can ye escape the damnation of hell?
And they «immediately» left the ship and their father, and followed him.
And they «straightway» left their nets, and followed him.
And «forthwith» he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.

G2106.d: to be well pleased, to think it good, to give consent; to be well pleased or take pleasure with or in a person or thing
s: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father’s good «pleasure» to give you the kingdom.
And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am «well» «pleased».
And there came a voice from heaven, saying, Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I «am» «well» «pleased».

G2198.d: to live, be alive; as I live; to live, pass one's life
s: And he said unto him, Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt «live».
And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the «living» God.
And they, when they had heard that he was «alive», and had been seen of her, believed not.

G2199.d: Zebedee, father of James and John the Apostles
s: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of «Zebedee», and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.

«Agree» with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.
That we should be saved from our «enemies», and from the hand of all that hate us;

G2127.d: to bless, prosper, bestow blessings on
s: Then took he him up in his arms, and «blessed» God, and said,
Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and «broad» is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:
For whether is «easier», to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and walk?
Even so, Father: for so it seemed «good» in thy sight.

G2168.d: -ῶ to be thankful, give thanks (chiefly in late writers and Inscr.; cf. Milligan, Th., 5; Ellic. on Lft., Notes, 9): of giving thanks before meat, 26:27, 14:23, 19, 23, with dative pens., τ. θεῷ, 28:15, 16:4, 12, Phm 4; before διὰ Ἰ. …
s: I «thank» God that I baptized none of you, but Crispus and Gaius;
Cease not to «give» «thanks» for you, making mention of you in my prayers;
And he took the cup, and «gave» «thanks», and gave it to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;
He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, It will be «fair» «weather»: for the sky is red.
And the «eunuch» answered Philip, and said, I pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other man?

G2134.d: to make a eunuch of, castrate
s: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother’s womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were «made» «eunuchs» of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven’s sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.
And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the «left».

G2197.d: Zacharias, father of John the Baptist
s: And when «Zacharias» saw him, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.
And from that time he sought «opportunity» to betray him.
And when a «convenient» day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;
(For all the Athenians and strangers which were there «spent» their «time» in nothing else, but either to tell, or to hear some new thing.)
And looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, «Ephphatha», that is, Be opened.
And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might «conveniently» betray him.
«Blessed» be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,
Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women which were «Greeks», and of men, not a few.

G2183.d: -ας, ἡ (ἐφήμερος), 1. a course of daily services ( al.). 2. a class or course of priests detailed for service in the temple ( al.): 8 (cf. MGr., ἐφημέριος, priest).† (AS)
s: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his «course»,

G2186.d: to stand upon; to be set over; to stand by, be present, be at hand, come on or upon
s: And as they spake unto the people, the priests, and the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees, «came» upon them,
And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed thereabout, behold, two men «stood» by them in shining garments:
And, behold, immediately there were three men already «come» unto the house where I was, sent from Cæsarea unto me.
And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, «devout» men, out of every nation under heaven.
And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is «fit» for the kingdom of God.
And he spake a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man «brought» «forth» plentifully:

G2165.d: to cheer, gladden; to be happy, rejoice, make merry
s: And again he saith, «Rejoice», ye Gentiles, with his people.
And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill it; and let us eat, and be «merry»:
It was meet that we should «make» «merry», and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.
And, behold, there was a man named «Zacch»æus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.

G2104.d: well born, of noble race; noble-minded
s: He said therefore, A certain «nobleman» went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.
And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called «benefactors».
And the chief priests and scribes stood and «vehemently» accused him.
And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at «enmity» between themselves.
He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, «Make» «straight» the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.
Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called «Ephraim», and there continued with his disciples.
Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of «joy» with thy countenance.
But refuse profane and old wives’ fables, and exercise thyself rather unto «godliness».
If we this day be examined of the «good» deed done to the impotent man, by what means he is made whole;
A «devout» man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway.
How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about «doing» «good», and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.

G2113.d: of ships, to run a straight course
s: Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a «straight» «course» to Samothracia, and the next day to Neapolis;
For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore ye ignorantly «worship», him declare I unto you.
Do therefore this that we say to thee: We have four men which have a «vow» on them;

G2181.d: ἡ Ephesus, a city in Asia Minor 21 18:24, 27 19:1, 17 19:26 (on the genitive, see M, Pr., 73) 16:8, 4:12, 2:1.† (AS)
s: And from Miletus he sent to «Ephesus», and called the elders of the church.
And the man in whom the evil spirit was «leaped» on them, and overcame them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
Whom he called together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, Sirs, ye know that by this craft we have our «wealth».
And when they heard these sayings, they were full of wrath, and cried out, saying, Great is Diana of the «Ephesians».

And there sat in a window a certain young man named «Eutychus», being fallen into a deep sleep: and as Paul was long preaching, he sunk down with sleep, and fell down from the third loft, and was taken up dead.

G2169.d: thankfulness, gratitude; giving of thanks, thanksgiving
s: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with «thanksgiving»;
Now I «pray» to God that ye do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.
But not long after there arose against it a tempestuous wind, called «Euroclydon».

G2114.d: -ῶ (ὔθυμος), 1. trans., to make cheerful (Æsch.). 2. Intrans. (Eur., Plut.; so mid. in Xen., Plat.), to be of good cheer: 25,.† (AS)

G2137.d: to prosper, be prospered, be successful

s: Backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, «inventors» of evil things, disobedient to parents,
For in that he died, he died unto sin «once»: but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.
For he that in these things serveth Christ is «acceptable» to God, and approved of men.
Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is «wellpleasing» in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
That ye may walk «honestly» toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.
Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, «acceptable» to God by Jesus Christ.

G2129.d: fair speaking, flattering speech; praise; In LXX and NT; the act of blessing; concrete, a blessing
s: Out of the same mouth proceedeth «blessing» and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.
With «good» will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:
So likewise ye, except ye utter by the tongue words «easy» to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye shall speak into the air.
For we are unto God a «sweet» savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:
By honour and dishonour, by evil report and «good» «report»: as deceivers, and yet true;
But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us, a measure to «reach» even unto you.

G2146.d: to look well, make a fair show
s: As many as desire to make a «fair» shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.
And be ye kind one to another, «tenderhearted», forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.

G2160.d: -ας, ἡ (εὖ, τρέπω), 1. versatility, wit, facetiousness (Hippocr., Plat., al.). 2. = βωμολογία, coarse jesting, ribaldry (Abbott, Essays, 93):.† SYN.: μωρολογία, see Tr., Syn., § xxxiv (AS)
s: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor «jesting», which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.
I beseech «Euodias», and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.
And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye «thankful».
That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to «distribute», willing to communicate;
When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother «Eunice»; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master’s «use», and prepared unto every good work.
Yea, and all that will live «godly» in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.
Do thy diligence to come before winter. «Eubulus» greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
But unto the Son he saith, Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: a sceptre of «righteousness» is the sceptre of thy kingdom.
Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he «feared»;

G2100.d: to be well pleasing; to be well pleased
s: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he «pleased» God.

G2125.d: to be cautious, to beware; to reverence
s: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, «moved» with «fear», prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.

Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so «easily» beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, «whereby» we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:
But to do «good» and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of «daily» food,
Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet, Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river «Euphrates».
